package-checked.eventDescription: One npm or PyPI package (optionally a specific version) checked: registry existence, age, maintainers, downloads, deprecation, licence, OSV vulnerabilities, typosquat and slopsquat signals. Charged once per package result written to the dataset (not charged when the registry lookup itself fails).

apify-actor-start.eventDescription: Synthetic start event charged automatically by Apify. Keep the default price; do not charge it in code.
